description_en: Modifies task information in Task Center
description_zh: 任务中心修改任务信息
name: ModifyTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the task is located
parameters.help_zh: 任务所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task to modify
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the task step to modify. Usage note: These two parameters are required in actual calls. If they are not provided, the Param.Invalid error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的任务步骤名称。调用说明：必填说明，告知调用方这两个参数在实际调用中为必填项，未提供时返回 Param.Invalid
parameters.name: step_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the API operation associated with the task. Usage note: These two parameters are required in actual calls. If they are not provided, the Param.Invalid error is returned. Usage note: Provide a complete list of valid values or instructions on how to obtain them (such as by calling an associated query API), and correct the current invalid example value CreateDBInstance to an actual valid TaskAction value
parameters.help_zh: 任务关联的 API 操作名称。调用说明：必填说明，告知调用方这两个参数在实际调用中为必填项，未提供时返回 Param.Invalid。调用说明：完整的有效值列表或获取方式说明（如关联查询 API），并修正当前无效的示例值 CreateDBInstance 为实际有效的 TaskAction 值
parameters.name: task_action

parameters.help_en: The operation parameters for the task
parameters.name: action_params

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the task modification fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务修改失败时返回的错误码

ErrorTaskId.description_en: The ID of the task that failed to be modified

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of successfully modified tasks
